dataset_name: ICAR Package of Practices (PoP) Master Agronomic Guidelines
authority: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) & State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: Urea in 3 splits: 50% basal, 25% active tillering, 25% panicle initiation

Rice.irrigation_guideline: Maintain 2-5 cm standing water from tillering to milk stage. Drain field 10-15 days prior to harvest.

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Azadirachtin 10000 ppm @ 1.5 L/ha at 15-20 days after transplanting
pest_management.chemical_threshold: BPH: 5-10 insects/hill; Stem Borer: 1 egg mass/m2 or 5% dead hearts

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: Urea in 2 splits: 50% basal with DAP/MOP, 50% at first irrigation (CRI stage ~21 days)

Wheat.irrigation_guideline: 4-6 irrigations; critical stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 21 DAS), Tillering (42 DAS), Jointing (65 DAS), Flowering (85 DAS), Milk (105 DAS).

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Trichoderma viride seed treatment @ 4-5 g/kg seed
pest_management.chemical_threshold: Yellow Rust: 1 pustule/plant in vulnerable spots requires immediate spray

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: Urea in 3 splits: 33% basal, 33% knee-high stage (V6), 33% tasseling

Maize.irrigation_guideline: Critical irrigation at knee-high, tasseling, silking, and grain filling stages.

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Neem oil @ 2 L/ha or Metarhizium anisopliae @ 2.5 kg/ha against FAW
pest_management.chemical_threshold: Fall Armyworm: 10% damaged plants in whorl stage

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: Urea in 3 equal splits: basal, square formation, and peak boll development

Cotton.irrigation_guideline: Avoid waterlogging; irrigate at vegetative, squaring, flowering, and boll development stages.

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Beauveria bassiana @ 2.5 kg/ha or Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 2.5 L/ha
pest_management.chemical_threshold: Whitefly: 6-8 adults/leaf; Pink Bollworm: 10% infested green bolls

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: Urea applied in 3 splits: at planting, 45 days, and 90 days after planting

Sugarcane.irrigation_guideline: Light frequent irrigation during germination and tillering (every 7-10 days).

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids @ 50,000/ha for early shoot borer

fertilizer_recommendation_kg_per_ha.split_schedule: 50% N + full P & K at planting; remaining 50% N during earthing up at 30-35 DAS

Potato.irrigation_guideline: First irrigation 5-7 days after planting; subsequent irrigations at 7-10 day intervals. Stop 10 days before dehaulming.

pest_management.bio_pesticide: Mancozeb 75% WP prophylactic spray followed by Trichoderma soil treatment
pest_management.chemical_threshold: Late Blight: any blighted leaflet reported under humid weather requires immediate contact spray
